preConditions.sqlCheck: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM information_schema.columns WHERE table_schema = 'clinlims' AND table_name = 'pathology_report' AND column_name IN ('version_number', 'voided', 'generated_at', 'generated_by')
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM information_schema.columns WHERE table_schema = 'clinlims' AND table_name = 'pathology_report' AND column_name = 'voided' AND data_type = 'boolean' AND is_nullable = 'NO'

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM information_schema.table_constraints WHERE table_schema = 'clinlims' AND table_name = 'pathology_report' AND constraint_type = 'FOREIGN KEY' AND constraint_name = 'pathology_report_generated_by_fk'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM clinlims.pathology_report WHERE id IN (990911, 990912, 990913, 990914) AND report_type = 'EXTERNAL' AND voided = false AND generated_by IS NULL
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM clinlims.pathology_report WHERE id = 990911 AND version_number = 1 AND generated_at = make_timestamp(2024,3,1,10,0,0)
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM clinlims.pathology_report WHERE id = 990913 AND version_number = 2 AND generated_at = make_timestamp(2024,3,3,10,0,0)
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM clinlims.pathology_report WHERE id = 990914 AND version_number = 1 AND generated_at = make_timestamp(2024,4,1,10,0,0)
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM clinlims.pathology_report WHERE id = 990912 AND version_number IS NULL AND generated_at IS NULL

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM pg_constraint WHERE conname = 'pathology_report_type_ck' AND pg_get_constraintdef(oid) LIKE '%DRAFT%' AND pg_get_constraintdef(oid) LIKE '%FINAL%' AND pg_get_constraintdef(oid) LIKE '%EXTERNAL%'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM pg_indexes WHERE schemaname = 'clinlims' AND tablename = 'pathology_report' AND indexname = 'pathology_report_version_uk' AND indexdef LIKE 'CREATE UNIQUE INDEX%'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM pg_constraint WHERE conname = 'pathology_stage_event_direction_ck' AND pg_get_constraintdef(oid) LIKE '%REOPEN%'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM pg_constraint WHERE conname = 'pathology_stage_event_return_reason_ck' AND pg_get_constraintdef(oid) LIKE '%FORWARD%'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM clinlims.pathology_stage_event WHERE id = 990921 AND direction = 'RETURN' AND reason = 'Recut'

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM information_schema.columns WHERE table_schema = 'clinlims' AND table_name = 'pathology_sample' AND column_name = 'critical_result_flagged' AND data_type = 'boolean' AND is_nullable = 'NO'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM clinlims.pathology_sample WHERE id IN (990901, 990902) AND critical_result_flagged = false
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM clinlims.reference_tables WHERE name = 'PATHOLOGY_REPORT' AND keep_history = 'Y' AND is_hl7_encoded = 'N'

changeSet.comment: Every assertion lives in the preConditions above.
